questions.question: 2026年各月费用总额趋势
questions.sql:
SELECT year, month, SUM(local_currency_amt) as total_amount
    FROM dwrfin.dwr_fin_cost_d_compre_subj_t
    WHERE year = '2026'
    GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

questions.question: 2026年5月各功能范围费用排名
questions.sql:
SELECT config_name as func_scope, SUM(amount) as total
    FROM dm.dm_fact_finance_cost_f
    WHERE month = '2026-05' GROUP BY config_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 2026年5月成本中心费用Top10
questions.sql:
SELECT cost_center_code, SUM(local_currency_amt) as total_amount
    FROM dwrfin.dwr_fin_cost_d_compre_subj_t
    WHERE year = '2026' AND month = '2026-05'
    GROUP BY cost_center_code ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 2026年5月制造费用按成本中心Top10
questions.sql:
SELECT cost_center, cost_center_describe, SUM(amount) as total
    FROM dm.dm_fact_finance_cost_f
    WHERE month = '2026-05' AND functional_scope = '4105'
      AND acc_acount NOT IN ('0041011040','0041011030','0061507000')
    GROUP BY cost_center, cost_center_describe ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 2026年1-5月费用预算vs实际对比
questions.sql:
SELECT month, SUM(amount) as actual, SUM(budget_cost) as budget,
           SUM(amount) - SUM(budget_cost) as gap
    FROM dm.dm_fact_finance_cost_f
    WHERE month >= '2026-01' AND month <= '2026-05'
    GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: 2026年1-5月费用同比分析
questions.sql:
SELECT month, SUM(amount) as current, SUM(ly_amount) as last_year,
           CASE WHEN SUM(ly_amount) > 0
                THEN ROUND((SUM(amount) - SUM(ly_amount)) / SUM(ly_amount) * 100, 2)
                ELSE NULL END as yoy_pct
    FROM dm.dm_fact_finance_cost_f
    WHERE month >= '2026-01' AND month <= '2026-05'
    GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: 2026年5月费用科目Top10

questions.question: 2026年各功能范围期间费用占比
questions.sql:
SELECT month, config_name,
           SUM(amount) as total,
           SUM(period_expense) as period_expense,
           ROUND(SUM(period_expense) / NULLIF(SUM(amount),0) * 100, 2) as expense_ratio
    FROM dm.dm_fact_finance_cost_f
    WHERE month >= '2026-01' AND month <= '2026-05'
    GROUP BY month, config_name ORDER BY month, config_name LIMIT 20

questions.question: 2026年5月各销售区域毛利排名

questions.question: 今年卫浴事业部业绩情况
questions.sql:
SELECT calmonth,
       SUM(ambperformance) as total_achievement,
       SUM(notax_sales_net_amt) as notax_amt,
       SUM(zxsmj) as sales_area
FROM dm.dm_fin_operations_mix_sum_t
WHERE calmonth >= '2026-01' AND calmonth <= '2026-06'
  AND node_desc2 = '卫浴事业部'
  AND data_source IN ('S', 'T', 'D', '')
GROUP BY calmonth
ORDER BY calmonth

questions.question: 2026年4月各事业部业绩排名
questions.sql: SELECT node_desc2, SUM(ambperformance) as actual FROM dm.dm_fin_operations_mix_sum_t WHERE calmonth = '2026-04' AND data_source IN ('S','T','D','') AND node_desc2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY node_desc2 ORDER BY actual DESC

questions.question: 2026年5月同比下滑的渠道
questions.sql: SELECT integrate_channel_code, SUM(month_achievement) as cur, SUM(last_year_month_achievement) as yoy, (SUM(month_achievement) - SUM(last_year_month_achievement)) / NULLIF(SUM(last_year_month_achievement),0) * 100 as yoy_rate FROM dm.ct_sales_performance_t WHERE calday = '20260531' GROUP BY integrate_channel_code HAVING SUM(month_achievement) < SUM(last_year_month_achievement) ORDER BY yoy_rate ASC

questions.question: 2026年4月同比下滑的渠道

questions.question: 瓷砖事业部2026年1-5月业绩趋势
questions.sql: SELECT calmonth, SUM(ambperformance) as actual FROM dm.dm_fin_operations_mix_sum_t WHERE calmonth BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-05' AND node_desc2 = '瓷砖事业部' AND data_source IN ('S','T','D','') GROUP BY calmonth ORDER BY calmonth

questions.question: 瓷砖事业部2026年1-5月成本与毛利趋势
questions.sql: SELECT calmonth, SUM(ambperformance) AS actual, SUM(actual_cost_exclude_logistics) AS cost_ex_log, SUM(gross_profit_after_sharing) AS gross_profit, SUM(gross_profit_after_sharing)/NULLIF(SUM(ambperformance),0)*100 AS margin_pct FROM dm.dm_fin_operations_mix_sum_t WHERE calmonth BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-05' AND node_desc2 = '瓷砖事业部' AND data_source IN ('S','T','D','') GROUP BY calmonth ORDER BY calmonth
